purpose: Clean prospective validation of own-model challenger; external Delta benchmark is observed only after local weekly state is sealed.
thursday_signal_gate: Use only information demonstrably available by Thursday UTC close.
Persist raw-source hashes, CMC snapshot identifier/timestamp, panel hash, feature rows, model state/refit state, all eligible scores and preliminary long/short ranking.
No external Delta print/result may be inspected for model modification before sealing.
If CMC snapshot availability time is ambiguous, use the latest strictly-prior snapshot; never assume same-day month-end availability.
friday_pre_entry_gate: Verify each intended short is currently active as a Binance USD-M perpetual using read-only live contract information before the shadow entry timestamp.
If fewer than 10 ranked shorts are verifiably shortable, block the week; no discretionary replacement after seeing returns.
Seal final 10 longs, 10 shorts, scores, exposure, turnover estimate, cost model and entry source coverage before Friday close.
Archive-based shortability may later corroborate the live seal but may not retroactively manufacture eligibility.
during_week: Record realized funding for each short with portfolio weight 0.05*exposure.
Record any delisting, contract suspension, missing source or execution anomaly as an explicit event; fail closed where required.
friday_exit_gate: Seal exit closes from frozen source policy.
Compute long PnL, short PnL, turnover cost, funding PnL and total PnL separately.
Never backfill a blocked prospective week as valid evidence.
benchmark_comparison_gate: Only after local result is sealed may new external Delta checkpoints be compared.
External Delta trajectory is benchmark evidence only, not a tuning input.
promotion_minimum: No promotion based on a single week or the historical 11-week match. Require months of sealed prospective observations plus stability/cost/source review.
